items.name: setup
items.title: Groundwork setup
items.description: Initialises a project on the token contract: installs @ja3dan/tokens and the lint plugin, wires the theme into global CSS, adds the @ja3dan registry to components.json. Run with shadcn init.
items.docs: Swap themes/neutral.css for another theme, or copy it into your project as your brand theme. Add @ja3dan/eslint-plugin's recommended config to eslint.config.mjs.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Complete table card: search, status and date-range filter pills, sortable columns, status pills, stage meters, density toggle, pagination, empty and no-results states. Replace the sample data with yours.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Base UI button with default, outline, secondary, ghost, destructive and link variants and optical icon padding.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text field with focus ring and aria-invalid state.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: Input with a leading icon and a trailing slot for clear buttons or units. The wrapper carries the border and focus ring.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Auto-growing multi-line field matching Input.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Form label, sentence case, text-xs medium.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Base UI checkbox with an enlarged hit area.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Base UI popover with header, title and description slots.

items.name: status-pill
items.title: Status pill
items.description: Status chip with a leading dot or icon in six tones (success, warning, danger, info, neutral, solid). Exports PILL and PILL_TONES for other pills.

items.name: progress-meter
items.title: Progress meter
items.description: Progress as filled segments rather than a bar, for things that move in steps.

items.name: view-toggle
items.title: View toggle
items.description: Segmented control for swapping one view of the same data for another.

items.name: table-card
items.title: Table card
items.description: The table look: TableCard with a titled header, tinted sentence-case column band, fixed row heights by density, hairline rows, StackedCell, and fixed column widths via `columns`.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: shadcn-compatible table primitives (Table, TableHeader, TableRow…) styled like table-card, for code that expects shadcn's API. New tables should use table-card.

items.name: sortable-table-head
items.title: Sortable table head
items.description: Clickable table-card column head with an arrow that turns with the sort direction and sets aria-sort. Button or link.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page numbers with collapsing gaps, a sliding thumb and rolling numbers. Buttons, or real links via hrefFor. Includes PaginationSummary.

items.name: filter-chip
items.title: Filter chip
items.description: Filter pill: “Status = Active” with a × to clear, options in a Base UI menu. Includes FilterBand and ClearFilters.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Icon, one line and a way forward, for empty tables and no-results.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: react-day-picker calendar with single and range selection, month/year dropdowns.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: Field that opens a calendar. min/max, disabled days, month-year dropdowns for far-off dates, clearable, invalid state.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date range picker
items.description: Range calendar with preset column (past or future), one or two months, bounds and disabled days. Includes DateRangeChip for filter bars.

items.name: use-data-table
items.title: useDataTable
items.description: Client-side search, typed filters, column sorting (nulls last) and pagination for any array of rows.

items.name: dates
items.title: Date helpers
items.description: Local-midnight day helpers: today, addDays, isSameDay, ISO parse/format, and range formatting.

items.name: motion
items.title: Motion presets
items.description: Shared spring and easing values for sliding thumbs and rolling content, with a reduced-motion fallback.
